title: Pega Groundbreakers Meetup Series - Charlotte, NC - November 4
summary: Join us for our casual, in-person events designed to bring our community together in cities across the globe.
body_markdown:
CONNECT, NETWORK, GROW


# Pega Groundbreakers Meetup Series 2026


Join us in Charlotte, NC for an exclusive in person networking event designed by Groundbreakers, for Groundbreakers.


**LOCATION: Fahrenheit DATE: Wednesday, November 4 TIME: 5:30 PM-7:30 PM**


Join fellow **Pega Groundbreakers** , clients, partners, practitioners, and employees for an in-person meetup in **Charlotte, North Carolina** on **Wednesday, November 4** at **Fahrenheit Charlotte** !


Groundbreakers Meetups are informal networking events designed to bring together members of the local Pega community to connect, share experiences, and build meaningful professional relationships. Whether you're a business leader, architect, developer, decision-maker, consultant, or Pega enthusiast, this is an opportunity to step away from day-to-day work and engage with others who are solving real business challenges with Pega.


**What to Expect:**


here is no formal agenda and no presentations. Instead, expect meaningful conversations with peers from across industries, along with opportunities to meet local Pega employees, community leaders, and fellow practitioners. The evening is centered on peer-to-peer networking, knowledge sharing, and building connections within the Charlotte-area Pega community, all while enjoying one of the city's premier rooftop venues.


**Why Attend?**


- Connect with Pega clients, partners, practitioners, and employees from across the Carolinas region
- Exchange practical insights and lessons learned with experienced peers
- Expand your professional network in a relaxed, community-focused setting
- Meet local Pega leaders and active community members
- Enjoy networking with panoramic views of the Charlotte skyline at Fahrenheit
- Be part of a growing Groundbreakers community built on collaboration and shared success


Whether you've been part of the Groundbreakers community for years or are just getting involved, this Charlotte meetup offers a chance to make new connections, exchange ideas, and strengthen relationships across the local Pega ecosystem.


**Registration is required. Space is limited.**


## Agenda


- **5:30 PM - 6:00 PM** — Check-in & name tags
- **5:30 PM – 7:00 PM** — Drinks, tapas & networking
- **7:00 PM** — Raffle time
- **7:30 PM** — Wrap-up
